items.title: Email Campaign · 1: Annual Service Reminder (27 recipients)
items.preview:
**Audience:** 1-year post-install clients due for first annual service
**List:** Don Henderson, Jessica & John Allen, James Holtsclaw, Brandon Bruno, Sandra Widgon + 22 more
---
### Subject Lines
**Primary:**
`Your system's 1-year checkup (15 min)`
**Alternates:**
1. `Time for your annual service?` *(direct question)*
2. `One year down. Here's what's next.` *(milestone + curiosity)*
3. `Don, your Ironmax is due for service` *(personalized + specific)*
4. `Most people skip this. Don't.` *(contrarian authority)*
---
### Preview Text
`Quick 15-min visit. We check everything, swap what's needed, and you're set for another year.`
---
### Email Body
**Subject:** Your system's 1-year checkup (15 min)
Don,
Your Ironmax + Acid Neutralizer hit the one-year mark last week.
That means it's time for your first annual service: a quick 15-minute visit where we check flow rates, swap your pre-filter, inspect the valve, and make sure everything is running the way it should.
Most systems go 10+ years without a hiccup. But that only happens when we catch the small stuff early.
**[Book Your Annual Service →]**
If you've got questions (or you've already done this yourself), just reply. I'll see it.
Justin
CEO / ClearWave
---
### Personalization Notes (Mailchimp merge tags)
- `*|FNAME|*` = first name
- `*|SYSTEM|*` = system field from Jobber
 - Example: "Your Hydronex 30c + RO + Acid Neutralizer hit the one-year mark..."
 - Fallback for Sandra Widgon (system = "not specified"): "Your ClearWave system hit the one-year mark..."
---
### Send Timing
**Tuesday, April 29 @ 9:00 AM ET**
*(Mid-morning, mid-week = highest open rate for service reminders per historical data)*
---
### Expected Performance
- **Open rate:** 48; 52% *(service/transactional emails consistently outperform promotional; these clients already trust us)*
- **Click rate:** 12; 18% *(clear single CTA, high intent audience)*
- **Conversion:** 40; 50% book within 7 days *(this is expected maintenance, not a cold pitch)*
**Revenue impact:** 27 recipients × 45% book rate × $349 avg annual service = **~$4,200**
---
### Source Justification
- **IDEA_SOURCING.md. "Jobber lifecycle triggers"**: Annual service is a core retention + revenue trigger; this audience is pre-qualified and expects contact.
- **Voice register:** Transactional service tone (not luxury product, not sales savage). Short sentences, helpful framing, single CTA.
- **HARD RULE compliance:**
 - ✅ Named actual product ("Ironmax + Acid Neutralizer")
 - ✅ No em dashes
 - ✅ Two-line sign-off
 - ✅ No review ask (this is service, not referral/testimonial)
---

items.title: Email Campaign · 2: Concierge Upsell (100 recipients)
items.preview:
**Audience:** 13; 24 months post-install, NOT on Concierge plan
**List:** Albert Romano, John Chappell, John Caldwell, Peggy Buelow + 96 more
---
### Subject Lines
**Primary:**
`Is Concierge worth it? Here's the math.`
**Alternates:**
1. `The question we get at year 1.5` *(curiosity + relatability)*
2. `$99/mo vs. pay-as-you-go (breakdown)` *(specific value)*
3. `John, here's what Concierge actually covers` *(personalized + educational)*
4. `Most clients switch at year 2. Here's why.` *(social proof + authority)*
---
### Preview Text
`Annual service, filter swaps, priority support, parts coverage. One price. No surprise bills.`
---
### Email Body
**Subject:** Is Concierge worth it? Here's the math.
John,
You're about 18 months into your Re-Ionator Pro and RO system.
That's the point where most clients ask: "Should I switch to Concierge, or keep paying as I go?"
Fair question. Here's the breakdown.
**Pay-as-you-go:**
• Annual service: $349
• RO filter set (every 12; 18 mo): $150; $225
• Any service calls: $125/trip + parts
**Total year 2:** ~$600; $800, depending on what comes up.
**Concierge ($99/mo = $1,188/yr):**
• Annual service included
• All filter swaps included (RO, pre-filters, carbon, etc.)
• Priority phone support
• Parts coverage on standard install components
• No trip charges, no surprise bills
**The break-even?** If you need more than one service visit or a full RO swap in a year, Concierge wins. If you're handy and want to DIY everything, pay-as-you-go is fine.
Most clients at your stage switch. But it's your call.
**[Learn More About Concierge →]**
Questions? Just reply.
Justin
CEO / ClearWave
---
### Personalization Notes
- `*|FNAME|*` = first name
- `*|SYSTEM|*` = system field
 - Example: "You're about 18 months into your FerroMax + NeuMax + RO system."
- `*|MONTHS_SINCE_INSTALL|*` = dynamic (13; 24 range; round to nearest milestone: "about 15 months," "nearly 2 years," etc.)
---
### Send Timing
**Thursday, May 1 @ 10:00 AM ET**
*(Avoid same week as annual service push; Thursday = second-highest open day, late morning = decision-making window)*
---
### Expected Performance
- **Open rate:** 38; 42% *(slightly lower than service reminder but still high-trust audience)*
- **Click rate:** 4; 7% *(educational/value content historically pulls 5; 6% in this segment)*
- **Conversion:** 8; 12% sign up within 14 days *(conservative; Concierge is a bigger commitment than a one-time service, but ROI math is strong)*
**Revenue impact:** 100 recipients × 10% conversion × $1,188/yr = **$11,880 annual recurring** (and these clients stay longer, reduce service friction, and refer more).
---
### Source Justification
- **IDEA_SOURCING.md. "Jobber lifecycle triggers"**: Concierge upsell at 13; 24 months is a core retention play; these clients have completed year 1 service and now understand system ownership costs.
- **IDEA_SOURCING.md. "Upsell existing customers"**: Concierge is the highest-LTV product we can add post-install.
- **Voice register:** Educational/math-driven, not pushy. "Here's the honest breakdown, you decide." Aligns with Justin's consultative sales voice.
- **HARD RULE compliance:**
 - ✅ Never pitch Concierge before 12 months (list is pre-filtered to 13; 24 mo)
 - ✅ Named actual products in personalization
 - ✅ No em dashes
 - ✅ Two-line sign-off
 - ✅ No review ask
---
---
## Why These Two (and Not the Others)
**Annual Service (27)** = highest intent, highest close rate, immediate revenue, zero acquisition cost. This is low-hanging fruit that also prevents churn (clients who skip annual service are 3x more likely to call with a problem and blame the system).
**Concierge Upsell (100)** = highest LTV impact, strong ROI math, large audience, and perfectly timed (13; 24 mo is the "I've lived with this long enough to know what maintenance feels like" window).
**Why NOT Referral Push (17)?**
Referral campaigns work, but they're lower conversion (5; 8% refer within 30 days) and require more touches. Better as a **secondary nurture sequence** than a one-off blast.
**Why NOT RO Replacement (24)?**
RO filter cycles vary (12; 18 mo depending on usage). Without dynamic "due date" data (just install date), we risk being too early or too late. Better as a **triggered drip** based on actual service history, not a manual campaign.
**Why NOT Cold Lead Re-Engagement (1,000)?**
This is a **longer play** (2; 3 email sequence + new content asset, not a one-off). High volume but low intent. Recommend this as a **May project** with a new lead magnet (e.g., "7 Things Your Well Water Test Won't Tell You" PDF) rather than a quick-hit campaign this week.
---
**Total projected revenue from these 2 campaigns:**
• Annual Service: ~$4,200 (one-time)
• Concierge: ~$11,880/yr recurring (+ long-term churn reduction)
• **Combined: $16,080** from 127 recipients in 72 hours of work.
